maddeler.e:
ننطفئ (form VII)
# نَنْطَفِئُ (nanṭafiʔu) /nan.tˤa.fi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# نَنْطَفِئَ (nanṭafiʔa) /nan.tˤa.fi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# نَنْطَفِئْ (nanṭafiʔ) /nan.tˤa.fiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
